others.route: Temporary residence permit (work permit), Immigration Department

note: Eswatini: the Ministry of Home Affairs' Immigration Department's permits section issues the temporary residence permits, work permits among them, to expatriates, each granted by a committee on its merits (the department's page, archive.org snapshot of 18 April 2024); an employee's temporary residence permit is applied for with the employer's covering letter and proof that the post was advertised (the permits page, snapshot of 13 November 2018). gov.sz doesn't answer this client, so both were read in archive.org's snapshots. The page names no performers' route, exemption or days, so none are modelled; the events promoters' permit for foreign artists that a newspaper reported earlier isn't the immigration route and isn't modelled.
